Sample location · Somerset

Taunton

Category C rigid lorry training, with Driver CPC and Operator CPC classroom courses.

Enquire about TauntonCall 01632 960214

Courses here

  • Category CRigid lorries
  • Driver CPCProfessional drivers
  • Operator CPCTransport managers

This base

Our Taunton base offers Category C rigid training alongside Driver CPC and Operator CPC in the classroom. If you need Category C+E or ADR, those run at our other bases.

Getting here

Getting there

We send directions to the Taunton site when your course is confirmed, including the best approach if you are arriving by car.

Parking

Learner car parking is available at the Taunton base. We confirm where to park when you book.

Directions

The site address, a map and joining instructions are sent with your course confirmation.

Courses at Taunton

The courses we run at Taunton.

  • Rigid lorries

    Category C

    Practical training for rigid goods vehicles over 3.5 tonnes, for drivers moving up from a car licence.

    Offered at Bristol, Taunton and Exeter

    Enquire about this course

  • Professional drivers

    Driver CPC

    Periodic training for professional drivers who need hours towards a Driver Qualification Card.

    Offered at Bristol and Taunton

    Enquire about this course

  • Sample course · Transport managers

    Operator CPC

    Preparation for people working towards the transport-manager qualification.

    Offered at Bristol and Taunton

    Enquire about this course

Facilities and vehicles

  • Vehicle

    Rigid goods vehicle

    The training vehicle for Category C, used for yard exercises and road driving.

  • Facility

    Training yard

    Off-road space for vehicle familiarisation, reversing and manoeuvres, so the basics are secure before time on the road.

  • Facility

    Classroom

    A classroom for Driver CPC and Operator CPC. ADR uses the classroom at the Bristol base.

  • Facility

    Parking

    Learner car parking at the base. We confirm where to park when your course is agreed.

Instructors

The teams who deliver training at this base.

  • Driving instructors

    Instructor team

    Driving instructors

    Our driving instructors take learners through practical licence training: getting to know the vehicle, yard manoeuvres, coupling and uncoupling, and road driving. They also explain what the practical test involves.

    Category C

    Bristol, Taunton and Exeter

  • Classroom instructors

    Instructor team

    Classroom instructors

    Our classroom instructors run the classroom courses. They explain what each course covers, who it is for, and how it differs from the licence routes.

    Driver CPC and Operator CPC

    Bristol and Taunton

Local knowledge

Road driving from Taunton covers the town and the Somerset roads around it, so you practise on the mix of town, main-road and country driving a working lorry driver meets.

Learner feedback

What learners say about training at Taunton.

Questions about Taunton

Which courses can I take at Taunton?

Category C, Driver CPC and Operator CPC. Category C+E runs at Bristol and Exeter, and ADR at Bristol.

Where is the Taunton base?

Taunton is one of our three training bases. We send the site address and directions when your course is agreed.

Ask about training at Taunton

Tell us which course you are interested in, and how you would like to be contacted.
